title: Lil Woof reacts: how did they survive
hook: How did he survive this landing?

beats.line: [chuckles] Game said land near the dock. [amused] My man is coming in sideways.
[gasps] Nah. Nah nah nah. [shocked] That plane did a full barrel roll and parked itself. [laughs] I seen dogs fall off a couch worse.
[sighs] Everybody on that flight, call your mama. [deadpan] Then call a lawyer.
[laughing] Two billion dollars of physics, and the plane said, I am a boat now. [whispers] Just accept it.
